title: Euler's column, fixed-free
model: a 10 x 10 x 200 mm steel column clamped at its base, 1 kN down on its top; 2.5 mm elements

factor.source: Euler: P_cr = pi^2 E I / (4 L^2) (Timoshenko & Gere, Theory of Elastic Stability, 2nd ed. (1961), ch. 2, the column fixed at one end and free at the other)
factor.reason: at L/h = 20 shear lowers the load by about 0.1 % and the clamp's hold of the root raises it as much; the eigensolve converges to 1e-10 and the mesh error at 2.5 mm is under 0.1 %
